Unclear whether there was coordinated bombing with a ground attack or just one bombing or one ground attack. Coded as Shelling/artillery/missile attack until further notice.

actor1: Alliance of Resistants and Patriots (ARP) Wazalendo
notes: On 19 September 2025, for the third consecutive day, overnight, Wazalendo factions Malaika and Nyakiliba clashed with each other in Mwenga center (Mwenga, Sud-Kivu) over the elimination of the illegal pay barriers imposed by Nyamilika Wazalendo faction. Malaika faction was supported by FARDC and Foka-Mike Mai Mai group, headed by the former provincial Minister of the Interior. Most schools were closed and only a few shops were open. Massive displacement of residents toward surrounding forests was observed. 3-4 civilians, including 1 woman, were killed and their bodies were found early in the morning on 20 September. Following these clashes, self-proclaimed Major General Nyikiriba and his men withdrew from the area, which was now controlled by Wazalendo Malaika, Foka Mike group, and FARDC.
